en: GSC window 15 Jul→11 Aug (all 28 rows of the Days tab summed by hand for the exact total instead of the rounded '1.6K' tile; the hand-summed clicks total of 87 matches the Total clicks tile and the hand-computed CTR of 5.42% matches the 5.4% tile): clicks 79→87, impressions 1,521→1,604, CTR 5.2%→5.4% and average position improved sharply 30.4→29.6.

Reminder: GSC and GA4 are rolling 28-day windows. The delta against 13 Aug is the window shifting (one new day in, one old day out), not any single day's traffic. Today's window dropped 14 Jul off the back and pulled in 11 Aug (117 impressions, 10 clicks — the strongest day in the window).

But one signal moved the other way and should be stated plainly: queries-with-impressions FELL for the first time after a long run of increases, 153→147 (−6). Coverage is contracting while impressions rise — meaning the gain came from existing queries being shown more often, not from new ones.

The quality of those +8 clicks is still the problem: almost all of it is brand. 'dxliving' went 43→51 (+8) while 'dx living' held flat at 24. Brand totals moved 67→75 clicks, which is 86.2% of all 87 clicks (84.8% on 13 Aug) — the brand share actually WIDENED. All 8 non-brand queries in the top 10 still return zero clicks.

Non-brand structure: 'best home builders adelaide' 110→114 impressions, still 0 clicks at average position 34.5 (identical to yesterday); 'quality home builders adelaide' 32→33 at position 48.4; 'best home builders in adelaide' (21, position 35.4) entered the top 10 in place of 'quality home builder adelaide'. The whole non-brand group remains parked in the 28–58 rank band — too deep to earn clicks.

MEASUREMENT ALERT — GA4 IS STILL NOT FIXED, now day 16. Measured today: 31 Jul–6 Aug = 1 session, 7–13 Aug = 1 session. Two consecutive 7-day windows both reading 1 session is noise around a zero floor, NOT a recovery signal. Checked directly on the live homepage: 0 GTM/gtag script tags loaded, window.gtag and window.google_tag_manager both undefined, dataLayer holds a single entry, no G- measurement ID.

Against 13 Aug not one detail of the root cause changed: still 4 GTM snippet copies, 7 raw gtm.js string occurrences in outerHTML, 2 <noscript> iframes, the same GTM-PZ9N8QTR container, the #dx-analytics-dedupe script still present and the __dxGtmLoaded flag still true. The remedy is identical: delete #dx-analytics-dedupe outright, then remove 3 of the 4 remaining snippets.

CONSEQUENTLY: every 28-day GA4 figure in this snapshot (sessions 174, engaged 118, key events 13, users 97, total events 1,224) is an under-count. The drop against 13 Aug (203/136/15/111/1,395) is NOT a traffic decline — it is the pre-29-Jul portion of the window shrinking a day at a time. In roughly 12 more days the 28-day window will read close to zero unless this is fixed.

AI assistant channel: still exactly 1 session from chatgpt.com / ai-assistant (0.57% of total), 100% engagement, 15 seconds, 7 events, 0 key events — no Perplexity, Gemini or Copilot appears anywhere in the source/medium table (all 10 rows read). This figure also sits inside the window affected by the tracking fault.

Ahrefs grew steadily: referring domains 406→410 (all-time 421→425), backlinks 418→422 (all-time 443→447). The notable change today is QUALITY: followed referring domains jumped 3→6 and followed backlinks 3→6 — a doubling, though the base remains very thin (6 of 410 domains followed = 1.5%; 416 of 422 backlinks are nofollow). DR still 0, organic keywords and traffic still 0. Health Score held at 100 (crawl at 04:23 today, 14 URLs, 0 errors). Crawled pages in Site Explorer held at 102 and the 404 count held at 5.

AI citations are FLAT at 18 for a fifth consecutive day (ChatGPT 10 across 3 pages, Copilot 8 across 2). AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini and Perplexity remain 0; Grok is paused by Ahrefs so it is recorded as null, not 0.

AI Visibility holds at 26/100. All 5 measurable dimensions are unchanged: Presence 2/10, Citation surface 1/10, Technical readiness 9/10 (6 of 7 signals, only llms.txt missing), Measurement 1/10. Third-party corpus stays at 0/10 but was NOT re-tested today and is flagged as such.
